name: build
on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 18.20.2
      # GA validations
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: ./ga
      - run: yarn run validate-change
        working-directory: ./ga
      # Preview validations
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: ./preview
      - run: yarn run validate-change
        working-directory: ./preview

name: NPM Auto Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'ga/package.json'
      - 'preview/package.json'

jobs:
  detect-releases:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      ga_changed: ${{ steps.check.outputs.ga_changed }}
      ga_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.ga_version }}
      preview_changed: ${{ steps.check.outputs.preview_changed }}
      preview_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.preview_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Check for version changes
        id: check
        run: |
          GA_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./ga/package.json').version")
          PREVIEW_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./preview/package.json').version")

          GA_OLD_VERSION=$(git show HEAD~1:ga/package.json 2>/dev/null | node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')).version" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          PREVIEW_OLD_VERSION=$(git show HEAD~1:preview/package.json 2>/dev/null | node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')).version" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          echo "GA: $GA_OLD_VERSION → $GA_VERSION"
          echo "Preview: $PREVIEW_OLD_VERSION → $PREVIEW_VERSION"

          if [ "$GA_VERSION" != "$GA_OLD_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "ga_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "ga_version=$GA_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "ga_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          if [ "$PREVIEW_VERSION" != "$PREVIEW_OLD_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "preview_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "preview_version=$PREVIEW_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "preview_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  release-ga:
    needs: detect-releases
    if: needs.detect-releases.outputs.ga_changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./ga
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build
      - run: cp ../README.md .

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --provenance --ignore-scripts --access public

      - name: Generate scoped release notes
        id: notes
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | grep -v preview | head -n 1 || echo "")

          if [ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            NOTES=$(git log "$PREV_TAG"..HEAD --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" -- ga/)
          else
            NOTES=$(git log -20 --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" -- ga/)
          fi

          if [ -z "$NOTES" ]; then
            NOTES="- Version bump to ${{ needs.detect-releases.outputs.ga_version }}"
          fi

          echo "$NOTES" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ga-release-notes.md"

      - name: Create tag and GitHub Release
        working-directory: .
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ needs.detect-releases.outputs.ga_version }}"
          TAG="v${VERSION}"

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag "$TAG"
          git push origin "$TAG"

          gh release create "$TAG" \
            --title "@stripe/react-connect-js@${VERSION}" \
            --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/ga-release-notes.md" \
            --latest

      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@91efab103c0de0a537f72a35f6b8cda0ee76bf0a # v2.1.1
        with:
          webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_CONNECT_EMBEDDED }}
          webhook-type: incoming-webhook
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "${{ job.status == 'success' && '✅' || '❌' }} ${{ job.status == 'success' && format('GA release `@stripe/react-connect-js@{0}` published!', needs.detect-releases.outputs.ga_version) || format('Failed to publish GA release `@stripe/react-connect-js@{0}`', needs.detect-releases.outputs.ga_version) }}\n<${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|View run> • Triggered by ${{ github.actor }}"
            }

  release-preview:
    needs: detect-releases
    if: needs.detect-releases.outputs.preview_changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./preview
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build
      - run: cp ../README.md .

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --provenance --ignore-scripts --access public --tag preview

      - name: Generate scoped release notes
        id: notes
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*-preview*' --sort=-v:refname | head -n 1 || echo "")

          if [ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            NOTES=$(git log "$PREV_TAG"..HEAD --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" -- preview/)
          else
            NOTES=$(git log -20 --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" -- preview/)
          fi

          if [ -z "$NOTES" ]; then
            NOTES="- Version bump to ${{ needs.detect-releases.outputs.preview_version }}"
          fi

          echo "$NOTES" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/preview-release-notes.md"

      - name: Create tag and GitHub Release
        working-directory: .
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ needs.detect-releases.outputs.preview_version }}"
          TAG="v${VERSION}"

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag "$TAG"
          git push origin "$TAG"

          gh release create "$TAG" \
            --title "@stripe/react-connect-js@${VERSION} (preview)" \
            --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/preview-release-notes.md" \
            --prerelease

      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@91efab103c0de0a537f72a35f6b8cda0ee76bf0a # v2.1.1
        with:
          webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_CONNECT_EMBEDDED }}
          webhook-type: incoming-webhook
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "${{ job.status == 'success' && '✅' || '❌' }} ${{ job.status == 'success' && format('Preview release `@stripe/react-connect-js@{0}` published!', needs.detect-releases.outputs.preview_version) || format('Failed to publish preview release `@stripe/react-connect-js@{0}`', needs.detect-releases.outputs.preview_version) }}\n<${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|View run> • Triggered by ${{ github.actor }}"
            }

    "test": "yarn run lint && yarn run test:unit --passWithNoTests && yarn run typecheck",

    "storybook": "start-storybook -p 6006 ",

    "validate-change": "yarn run test",
    "validate-changes": "yarn run test"

    "type": "git",

version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "npm" 
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "daily"
    # Setting to 0 blocks updates for non-security related package dependencies updates
    open-pull-requests-limit: 0
    target-branch: "master"

  - package-ecosystem: "npm" 
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "daily"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 0
    target-branch: "preview"

singleQuote: true
trailingComma: es5
bracketSpacing: false
arrowParens: always
proseWrap: always

singleQuote: true
trailingComma: es5
bracketSpacing: false
arrowParens: always
proseWrap: always

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES6", // Let Babel deal with transpiling new language features
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "jsx": "react",
    "noEmit": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "allowJs": true,
    "removeComments": false,
    "strict": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true
  },
  "include": ["./src"]
}

---
root: true
extends:
  - eslint:recommended
  - plugin:@typescript-eslint/eslint-recommended
  - plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended
  - plugin:react/recommended
parser: "@typescript-eslint/parser"
parserOptions:
  # project: './tsconfig.json'
  ecmaFeatures:
    jsx: true
plugins:
  - "@typescript-eslint"
  - jest
  - react
  - react-hooks
settings:
  react:
    version: detect
env:
  jest/globals: true
  browser: true
  es6: true
rules:
  no-console: 0
  func-style: 2
  consistent-return: 2
  prefer-arrow-callback:
    - 2
    - allowNamedFunctions: false
      allowUnboundThis: false
  jest/no-disabled-tests: 2
  jest/no-focused-tests: 2
  react/prop-types: 0
  react/forbid-prop-types: 0
  react/no-unused-prop-types: 0
  react-hooks/rules-of-hooks: 2
  react-hooks/exhaustive-deps: 1
  "@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any": 0
  "@typescript-eslint/no-empty-interface": 0
  "@typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type": 0
  "@typescript-eslint/camelcase": 0
  "@typescript-eslint/no-empty-function": 0
  "@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars":
    - 2
    - varsIgnorePattern: ^_
  "@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports": "error"
